defects.title: Floating-Point Currency Rounding Artifacts in Line Totals
defects.description: Calculating price * quantity without decimal quantization produces IEEE-754 floating-point artifacts (e.g. 19.99 * 7 = 139.92999999999998 instead of $139.93).
defects.rootCause: Double-precision IEEE-754 binary floating-point representation lacks native decimal quantization, causing float overflow artifacts on multiplications like 19.99 * 7.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Add 7 units of item priced at $19.99.
2. Calculate line total.
3. Observe raw unrounded float.
defects.fixExplanation: Applied round_money() with EPSILON to guarantee two-decimal precision.

defects.title: Fractional / Decimal Quantities Accepted in Cart
defects.description: System accepts non-integer values (e.g. 2.5) because validation only checks if number > 0, leading to fractional inventory and prices.
defects.rootCause: Insufficient type checking only confirmed quantity was positive (qty > 0) without ensuring it was a whole integer.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Attempt to add 2.5 items to cart.
2. Cart updates with quantity 2.5.
defects.fixExplanation: Enforced isinstance(num, int) check inside quantity validation.

defects.title: Cart Quantity Can Exceed Total Physical Warehouse Stock
defects.expected: success: false, Error: Cannot add 4. Only 2 more available.
defects.description: If a customer already has 3 units in cart and adds 4 more when total stock is 5, system fails to verify cumulative cart quantity against inventory.
defects.rootCause: Inventory verification only checked newly submitted quantity against physical stock, ignoring existing quantities already reserved in customer's active cart.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Product stock is 5.
2. Cart already holds 3.
3. Add 4 more.
4. Cart now holds 7 (oversold).
defects.fixExplanation: Added cumulative stock bounds check (current_qty + qty <= stock).

defects.title: Empty Cart Checkout Creates Invalid Ghost Order
defects.expected: success: false, error: Cannot checkout with an empty cart
defects.description: Calling checkout submission with empty cart succeeds, generating a $0 order invoice and polluting order history.
defects.rootCause: Missing guard clause checking cart length before initializing order processing, allowing ghost orders with $0 total.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Empty shopping cart.
2. Submit checkout payload.
3. Order is created.
defects.fixExplanation: Added non-empty cart guard check before order processing.

defects.title: Customer Details Accepts Whitespace Name & Alphanumeric Phone
defects.description: Form accepts spaces-only string ("   ") for name and letters inside phone numbers ("98765PHONE") due to simple length checks.
defects.rootCause: Inadequate input sanitation using simple length check without trimming whitespace and lack of strict regex patterns for name and phone.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Enter "   " in name field.
2. Enter "12345ABCDE" in phone.
3. Submit form.
defects.fixExplanation: Enforced string strip and strict regular expressions for name and phone.

defects.title: Payment Gateway Accepts Past Expiration Year & Single-Digit CVV
defects.expected: isValid: false (Expiry must be in future, CVV 3-4 digits)
defects.description: Expired credit card date (01/20) and 1-digit CVV ("9") are accepted because expiry is only checked for format MM/YY rather than date comparison.
defects.rootCause: Syntax-only regex verification for MM/YY format without comparing date against current calendar month/year, and missing CVV length restriction.
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Enter Card Expiry "01/20".
2. Enter CVV "9".
3. Submit card payment.
defects.fixExplanation: Integrated calendar comparison against current date and CVV length regex (/^\d{3,4}$/).
